name: Nuvama Wealth Management Ltd
title: Nuvama Wealth Management Ltd - 543988 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Earnings Call Transcript

read.thesis: Wealth and private growth carries the firm: wealth and private now 55% of revenue, operating PAT about INR1,050 crore, with MPIS net flows about 30% of opening assets and capital markets moderating.

triggers.label: MPIS net flows about 30% of opening
triggers.quote: Net flows have grown by 38%, representing about 30% over the opening assets.
triggers.highlight: representing about 30% over the opening assets

triggers.label: Asset services yield held on cash mix
triggers.quote: I don't think the yield will compress because we've seen a decline in the overall interest rates happen and that flow-through has largely happened.
triggers.highlight: I don't think the yield will compress

triggers.label: Capital markets ECM subdued in Q4
triggers.quote: Q4 was when things got pushed a bit and which we should see the recovery happen in the coming quarters.
triggers.highlight: Q4 was when things got pushed a bit

guidance.quote: Our net flows continue to remain strong, about 22% of opening assets in line with our full year guidance.

guidance.value: around 100 bps reduction every year over 3-4 years
guidance.quote: broadly like we keep saying over a 3- 4-year period, you can see a 100 basis point reduction every year.

guidance.value: INR3,000-3,500 crore target, launch H2 FY27
guidance.quote: I think second half of this year is where we should look to launch. Again, the target should be anywhere between INR3,000-INR3,500 crores
we expect to launch our first fund. I think by end of Q2, again, maybe target about INR1,000 crores, INR1,200 crores or INR1,500 crores in the first fund

prior_guidance_check.metric: Private ARR net flows about 22% of opening assets
prior_guidance_check.quote: Our net flows continue to remain strong, about 22% of opening assets in line with our full year guidance.

red_flags.label: Asset services yield rise from cash mix
red_flags.quote: Yes, the cash component would have gone up. That is the reason why the yield has gone up

red_flags.label: NII lagging loan book growth
red_flags.quote: Net interest income for the year did not grow in line with the loan book

evasions.quote: I don't think we will go through that. I mean it's not a topic which got discussed very frankly, internally.
